Name: Local Motorcycle
Author: miong94804
Description:
这是一个《星露谷物语》SMAPI Mod，为本地玩家添加摩托车骑乘效果。
当前版本为测试版，已支持四方向显示、骑行切换、本地速度提升和基础骑乘表现。
该 Mod 主要用于提供“本地骑摩托”的视觉与移动体验，不会强制影响未安装 Mod 的其他联机玩家。
[b]当前功能[/b]
[list]
[*]按 K 切换摩托骑行状态[/*]
[*]支持前、后、左、右四方向显示[/*]
[*]骑行时提高移动速度[/*]
[*]支持基础上下车切换[/*]
[*]支持骑行状态下打开背包与进行常规操作[/*]
[*]支持本地尾气与基础骑乘动画[/*]
[*]联机下默认仅对安装者本地生效[/*]
[/list][b]联机说明[/b]
[list]
[*]本 Mod 为本地显示型 Mod[/*]
[*]安装了 Mod 的玩家可以看到自己的骑摩托效果[/*]
[*]未安装 Mod 的其他联机玩家不会自动获得该效果[/*]
[*]不会把摩托资源同步给其他玩家[/*]
[*]适合“个人视觉增强”或“本地骑乘体验”使用[/*]
[/list][b]安装需求[/b]
[list]
[*]《星露谷物语》 1.6+[/*]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/*]
[/list][b]安装方法[/b]
[list=1]
[*]先安装 SMAPI[/*]
[*]将 LocalMotorcycle 文件夹放入游戏的 Mods 目录[/*]
[*]使用 SMAPI 启动游戏[/*]
[*]进入存档后按 K 切换摩托状态[/*]
[/list][b]操作说明[/b]
[list]
[*]K：开启 / 关闭摩托[/*]
[/list][b]已知问题[/b]
[list]
[*]当前版本仍为测试版，骑乘姿态仍在继续优化[/*]
[*]人物与车体的贴合表现还不完全等同于原版骑马效果[/*]
[*]不同朝向下的视觉表现还会继续调整[/*]
[*]当前更偏向“本地骑乘原型”而非完整载具系统[/*]
[/list][b]后续计划[/b]
[list]
[*]继续优化骑乘姿态[/*]
[*]改进摩托贴图与原版像素风一致性[/*]
[*]优化四方向骑乘表现[/*]
[*]进一步调整速度、上下车动作与工具使用表现[/*]
[/list][b]作者说明[/b]
这个 Mod 目前处于持续迭代中，欢迎反馈截图、方向表现问题和骑乘姿态建议。
[line]
[b]英文发布说明[/b]
[b]Title[/b]
Local Motorcycle / Alpha Test
[b]Description[/b]
This is a SMAPI mod for Stardew Valley that adds a local-only motorcycle riding effect for the player.
The current release is an alpha test version with four-direction visuals, toggleable riding, local speed boost, and basic riding presentation.
This mod is mainly designed as a local riding experience and does not force other multiplayer players to see or install it.
[b]Current Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Press K to toggle motorcycle mode[/*]
[*]Supports up, down, left, and right motorcycle visuals[/*]
[*]Increases movement speed while riding[/*]
[*]Basic mount / dismount transition[/*]
[*]Allows inventory access and normal interaction while riding[/*]
[*]Includes local exhaust and basic riding animation[/*]
[*]In multiplayer, the effect is local to the player who installed the mod[/*]
[/list][b]Multiplayer Notes[/b]
[list]
[*]This is a local-visual mod[/*]
[*]Players who install it can see their own motorcycle effect[/*]
[*]Other players without the mod will not automatically receive the visuals[/*]
[*]The motorcycle assets are not synced to other players[/*]
[*]Best suited for personal visual gameplay enhancement[/*]
[/list][b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/*]
[/list][b]Installation[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI[/*]
[*]Drop the LocalMotorcycle folder into your game's Mods folder[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI[/*]
[*]Load a save and press K to toggle the motorcycle[/*]
[/list][b]Controls[/b]
[list]
[*]K: Toggle motorcycle on / off[/*]
[/list][b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
[*]This version is still in active testing[/*]
[*]The rider pose is still being refined[/*]
[*]Character-to-bike fit does not yet fully match the vanilla horse-riding feel[/*]
[*]Directional visuals may be improved further in future updates[/*]
[*]This is currently more of a local riding prototype than a full vehicle system[/*]
[/list][b]Planned Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]Improve the rider pose[/*]
[*]Improve pixel-art consistency with vanilla Stardew Valley[/*]
[*]Refine four-direction riding visuals[/*]
[*]Further tune speed, mounting behavior, and tool/inventory interactions[/*]
[/list][b]Author Note[/b]
This mod is still under active iteration. Feedback, screenshots, and pose/visual suggestions are welcome.
